```{r load}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
df <- read_csv("../data/bc_full_factorial_dataset.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Exercise 1 — Compute SE for condition 1

```{r ex1-solution}
cond1 <- df %>% filter(condition_id == 1)
yields <- cond1$BC_yield_gL

# By hand
n <- length(yields)
total <- 0
for (y in yields) total <- total + y
mean_val <- total / n

sq <- 0
for (y in yields) sq <- sq + (y - mean_val)^2
sd_val <- sqrt(sq / (n - 1))
se <- sd_val / sqrt(n)
t_crit <- qt(0.975, df = n - 1)
lower <- mean_val - t_crit * se
upper <- mean_val + t_crit * se

cat(sprintf("Mean = %.3f, SD = %.3f, SE = %.3f\n", mean_val, sd_val, se))
cat(sprintf("95%% CI: [%.3f, %.3f]\n", lower, upper))

# R check
cat(sprintf("R: mean=%.3f sd=%.3f se=%.3f\n", mean(yields), sd(yields), sd(yields)/sqrt(n)))
```

## Exercise 2 — How many replicates?

```{r ex2-solution}
pooled_sd <- df %>%
  group_by(condition_id) %>%
  summarise(s = sd(BC_yield_gL), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pull(s) %>%
  mean()
cat(sprintf("Pooled SD estimate: %.3f\n", pooled_sd))

target <- 0.1
# Solve: t_{n-1} * sigma / sqrt(n) <= 0.1
for (n in 3:200) {
  t_crit <- qt(0.975, df = n - 1)
  half_width <- t_crit * pooled_sd / sqrt(n)
  if (half_width <= target) {
    cat(sprintf("Need n >= %d replicates (half-width = %.4f)\n", n, half_width))
    break
  }
}
```

## Exercise 3 — Multiple comparisons

```{r ex3-solution}
cond1500 <- df %>% filter(condition_id == 1500)
target_yield <- mean(cond1500$BC_yield_gL)

cond_means <- df %>%
  group_by(condition_id) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(BC_yield_gL), .groups = "drop")

results <- cond_means %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    p_raw = t.test(
      cond1500$BC_yield_gL,
      df %>% filter(condition_id == cur_group()$condition_id) %>% pull(BC_yield_gL)
    )$p.value,
    p_bonf = min(p_raw * nrow(cond_means), 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

n_sig <- sum(results$p_bonf < 0.05)
cat(sprintf("Significant at alpha=0.05 (Bonferroni): %d out of %d conditions\n",
            n_sig, nrow(results)))
```

## Exercise 4 — Error bar plot

```{r ex4-solution, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
top10 <- cond_means %>%
  head(10) %>%
  left_join(
    df %>%
      group_by(condition_id) %>%
      summarise(se = sd(BC_yield_gL) / sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "condition_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(ci95 = 1.96 * se)

ggplot(top10, aes(x = factor(condition_id), y = m)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = m - ci95, ymax = m + ci95), width = 0.2) +
  labs(x = "Condition ID", y = "Mean yield (g/L)", title = "Top 10 conditions: Mean ± 95% CI") +
  theme_minimal()
```
